name: Guard Thomas
summary: At the bridge west of Eastvale Logging Camp, Guard Thomas watches Elwynn’s eastern frontier. The Stormwind soldier guards local workers from wild predators and murlocs.

sections.title: On the Eastern Border
sections.body: At the stone bridge over the river toward Eastvale Logging Camp, Guard Thomas holds a quiet but exposed post. The woods around him shelter aggressive creatures, and the logging workers depend on the Stormwind guard for protection. With the army stretched thin, Thomas must rely on travelers to help keep order and carry messages to central command.

sections.title: Frontier Troubles
sections.body: Aggressive bears and prowlers threaten lumberjacks and travelers along Elwynn’s eastern treeline. Murloc tribes have made camps by the waterways, and Guard Thomas tracks them and offers bounties to reduce their numbers. Patrols sent along the river sometimes vanish, leaving Thomas to work out what became of his fellow guards as troubles mount in the region.

faq.q: Where can I find Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas stands on the stone bridge over the river, just west of Eastvale Logging Camp on Elwynn Forest’s eastern road.

faq.q: What is Guard Thomas's duty in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas protects Elwynn’s eastern frontier for the Stormwind Army. He guards the trade bridge, defends nearby workers from predators, and watches for murlocs along the riverbanks.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas asking for help with lost guards?
faq.answer: Patrols sent into the river basins have failed to return. Unable to leave his post without enough guards to replace him, Thomas asks travelers to search the waterways for his missing comrades.

faq.q: Why are murlocs a problem for Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Murloc tribes are pressing farther up eastern Elwynn’s rivers. They threaten logging work and supply routes, so Thomas offers bounties to keep the waterways clear.

faq.q: Who does Guard Thomas report to?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas serves in the Stormwind Army and reports through its hierarchy to regional command in Goldshire and the capital. As trouble grows along the borders, his dispatches also coordinate with Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

faq.q: Where does Guard Thomas send adventurers once their work in Elwynn is done?
faq.answer: After threats near Eastvale and the eastern river are dealt with, Thomas directs seasoned travelers toward Westfall to help Gryan Stoutmantle and the struggling People's Militia.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you see how thinly the Stormwind Army is stretched: Guard Thomas holds a vital frontier post with little support from the crown.
As a young Alliance warrior, you can look to Thomas for an example of frontline discipline and the hard work of defending a regional border.
